description.en: A luminous ocean-fantasy tea campaign built from crystal glass, iridescent liquid, and editorial typography.

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a luxury fantasy tea advertisement poster for {argument name="product name" default="MARINE LUCENT"}, themed as an oceanic, character-inspired magical tea extracted from an ethereal mermaid-like heroine. The mood is translucent, premium, dreamy, and not a normal cafe menu.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 high-resolution poster, soft pastel blue, lavender, pearl white, and iridescent aqua palette. Use glossy commercial advertising composition with delicate typography and a high-fashion fantasy tea brand atmosphere.

Layout: Place the main product scene on the right and lower center: a clear glass teapot in the upper-right pours glowing blue-violet tea in a sparkling stream into a transparent glass teacup on a saucer at the lower center. On the left side, create a refined editorial text column with the brand logo at top, product title in large serif letters, subtitle, flavor copy, and ingredient list. Add a pale lavender rectangular placeholder block near the upper-left/center, partially covering the background character art. Keep the whole design airy, luminous, and layered with bokeh, water reflections, and glass highlights.

Background and subject details: Behind the tea, show a barely visible ethereal anime-style marine princess figure as a soft-focus illustration: long flowing aqua-blue hair, shell and pearl accessories, pale skin, delicate floral/starfish ornaments, translucent fabric, and an underwater fantasy aura. She should feel like the source of the tea’s identity and world, but remain mostly hidden behind mist, glass, and typography.

Main visual: The teapot is round, transparent, crystal-like, and filled with vivid magical tea in gradients of electric blue, cobalt, violet, and cyan. Inside the tea, show exactly 8 visible floating decorative elements: 3 lavender star-shaped flowers, 2 pale pearl-shell spheres, 1 small golden starfish, 1 purple blossom cluster, and 1 cloud of glittering bubbles. The pouring stream should look like liquid starlight, with tiny bubbles and radiant sparkles. The teacup contains the same glowing ocean tea, with suspended flowers, bubbles, shell-like pearls, and refracted light. Add a glass saucer, a small starfish charm, pearls, seashells, crystalline ice-like rocks, and a tiny ornate perfume-bottle-like vessel in the background.

Text content: At the top-left, create a diamond monogram logo with the letter “M”, then the brand name “MAISON DE LUMIÈRE” and small line “FINE FANTASY TEA”. Add the tagline in Japanese “彼女の世界を、あなたの一杯に。” and below it “Her world, in your teacup.” Set the product title as large elegant serif text: “{argument name="headline text" default="MARINE LUCENT"}”. Below it add small Japanese reading “マリン・ルーセント”. Add the flavor name “{argument name="flavor name" default="AURORA BLUE BLOOM"}” and Japanese reading “オーロラブルー・ブルーム”. Add a short Japanese body copy block, then English copy: “The sparkle of waves, the dance of bubbles, the gentleness of a clear blue breeze—blended into a tea that is pure, radiant, and enchantingly alive.” Add an ingredient list with exactly 6 items and small matching icons: “BLUE PEA”, “WHITE TEA”, “CORNFLOWER”, “PEARL SHELL”, “CITRUS & PEACH”, and “SEA SALT DROP”, each with smaller Japanese text underneath. At bottom-right, add handwritten script: “{argument name="signature phrase" default="Sip the Ocean’s Whisper."}” with Japanese “海のささやきを、ひとくちに。” and the brand name “MAISON DE LUMIÈRE”.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed glossy fantasy advertising, premium cosmetics-ad lighting, crystalline glass refractions, shimmering caustics, pearlescent highlights, soft bloom, layered transparency, pastel marine glow, elegant serif typography mixed with delicate script. Make the typography readable and balanced, with the title dominating the left lower half.

Constraints: Use exactly one teapot and one teacup. Use exactly 6 listed ingredient rows. Preserve the luxury tea poster format, do not make it a cafe menu, product package, or character sheet. Avoid extra brand logos, watermarks, QR codes, or unrelated objects.

entries.prompt:
Design a high-end e-commerce pastry packaging solution for [Brand Name] that can be mass-produced. The product name is [Product Name], the product type is [Pastry Type], the brand positioning is [Brand Positioning], and the target audience is [Target Users]. Packaging types include [Heaven-and-Earth Lid Gift Box / Drawer Box / Window Color Box / Handheld Gift Box / Magnetic Gift Box / Color Box / Paper Tube / Soft Bag / E-commerce Shipping Gift Box]. The finished product dimensions are [Length × Width × Height mm]. Internal specifications are [quantity] pieces or [combination pack], and each piece is specified as [Single Weight or Size].    

Please design a professional-grade high-end e-commerce pastry packaging design proposal board. Overall, it must meet international packaging design award-level standards, combining brand recognition, main e-commerce image appeal, shelf display effect, gift value, structural rationality, printability, transportation protection, and factory mass production feasibility.

The overall style is [Oriental New Luxury / Minimalist and Sophisticated / Natural Organic / Young National Trend / New Chinese Elegance / Vintage Collection / Holiday Gifts / Light Luxury Souvenirs / French Dessert Style / Japanese Minimalist / Regional Culture Style]. The visual temperament should be high-end, refined, clean, appetizing, and have brand memorability, avoiding a sense of cheapness, clutter, and template-like feeling. The color scheme should focus on the main color, paired with auxiliary colors and accent colors. The overall color should match the product's taste, brand positioning, and gifting scenario.

The image is a horizontal professional packaging design proposal board, clearly divided into zones, with advanced layout, reasonable white space, and complete information. It includes: main visual 3D packaging rendering, front of packaging, back of packaging, left left, right right, top top, bottom bottom, internal structure of unboxing, cake tray display, complete unfolding knife pattern diagram, dimensioning, line pattern legend, material description, printing process description, partial process enlargement drawing, color scheme, font scheme, and manufacturer production information.

The main visual 3D packaging rendering should show the packaging box from a 45° stereoscopic perspective, with authentic packaging materials, delicate paper texture, clear box thickness, reasonable structure, and soft, high-end light and shadow. Surrounding items can be arranged with real pastries, ingredients, tea sets, plates, wooden trays, ribbons, flowers, grains, nuts, fruits, cream, sesame, egg yolks, red beans, cocoa, honey, wheat ears, festive elements, or regional cultural elements to create a high-end e-commerce main image. The color and shape of the pastries must match the specific product type and are not limited to green.

The front design must include the brand name, product name, English auxiliary name, core selling points, net content, specification information, brand symbol, and main visual design. The main visual can use pastry photography, illustrations, patterns, window structures, oriental graphics, regional cultural symbols, raw material graphics, abstract brand symbols, or holiday designs. The composition needs to be strongly memorable, suitable for e-commerce thumbnail clicks.

The back design must include the product name, ingredient list, allergen warnings, nutrition facts sheet, production information, storage methods, consumption recommendations, standards, production license number, manufacturer information, barcode, QR code, environmental label, and a reserved area for the production batch number. The information hierarchy is clear, and the layout is authentic and trustworthy. The left and right sides should include the brand slogan, product series name, flavor label, unboxing direction, decorative patterns, or brand auxiliary graphics. The top displays brand symbols, gift box opening methods, sealing structures, or main visual extension patterns. The bottom displays the folded structure, production batch number location, environmental label, or simplified information area.

The internal structure display must include food-grade PET trays, eco-friendly pulp trays, paper card partitions, individual small boxes, individual packaging bags, or greaseproof paper linings. Each pastry is placed independently, ensuring shock resistance, pressure resistance, flavor transfer, oil stain resistance, and e-commerce transportation safety. The pastries have realistic shapes and appetizing appeals, with naturally sophisticated colors.

The unfolding tool diagram must show the complete packaging unfolding structure, including front, back, left and right sides, top, bottom, tongue insert, latch, adhesive position, window area, internal tray diagram, barcode QR code position, size marking, and process layout. The die diagram must resemble the actual packaging engineering drawing, with accurate proportions and clear lines, making it suitable for manufacturer sample reference.

The die drawing must be clear, professional, and mass-producible, with all units in mm. Line type legends must be annotated: Red solid line = cutting line / cutting line; Blue dashed line = indentation line / polyline; Green line = bleeding line; Purple line = safety line; Gray line = reference line, not printed; Yellow area = adhesive position; Translucent light blue area = food-grade PET window area; Gold area = hot stamping edition; Bright white area = partial UV version; Embossed shadow area = bump / recess area.

Size standard: bleeding 3 mm per side; Safety margin 5 mm; Dimensional tolerance ±1 mm; Die-cutting tolerance ±0.5 mm; Printing nest tolerance ±0.3 mm; Barcode areas must be clearly marked with a white background; QR codes must be reserved in the scanning safe area; The food label information area must be clear and legible; All folds, tongue inserts, adhesive points, and window areas must be clearly marked.

Material recommendations: [350g food-grade white card paper / 400g food-grade white card paper / specialty paper / grayboard mounting / kraft paper / eco-friendly pulp / biodegradable paper tray / food-grade PET / food-grade oilproof paper / aluminum foil inner bag / individual small packaging]. The food-contact section must use food-grade materials, and e-commerce transportation must consider pressure resistance, shock resistance, moisture resistance, oil stain resistance, and odor transfer.

Printing method: CMYK four-color printing, with Pantone spot colors, metal spot colors, and special plate processes available. Surface Processing: [Matte Film / Glossy Film / Tactile Film / Localized UV / Hot Stamping / Silver Hot Stamping / Rose Gold Hot Stamping / Embossing / Embossing / Embossing / Pearlescent Ink / Spot Color Printing / Food-Grade Eco-friendly Ink].

The partial process enlargement should display the logo stamping, brand name accents, product name partial UV exposure, paper embossing, illustration details, window PET frame, lock structure, inner tray details, and food label information area. The color scheme should display the main color, secondary color, accent color, and indicate the Pantone color code, CMYK value, RGB value, or approximate color value. The font scheme should display the brand's Chinese font, product name font, English auxiliary font, numeric font, and information font.

Overall image requirements: award-winning pastry packaging design, premium bakery packaging, high-end confectionery packaging, luxury e-commerce dessert gift box, production-ready packaging blueprint, manufacturer-ready dieline layout, structural packaging engineering drawing, realistic paper texture, refined typography, premium brand identity system, elegant food packaging design, photorealistic 3D packaging mockup, detailed printing process annotations, CMYK print-ready layout, Pantone color system, gold foil stamping, embossed logo, debossed texture, spot UV details, food-grade PET window, inner tray structure, sustainable food packaging, premium gift box design, clean white studio background, soft natural lighting, ultra detailed, high resolution, commercial product design board

description.en: A layered paper-sculpture library where an explorer, celestial books, airships, and brass details form a dense fantasy tableau.

entries.prompt: A highly detailed 3D layered paper sculpture 3D set in a floating cosmic library, blending fantasy and steampunk aesthetics. At the center of the composition is a contemplative young explorer, with long silver striped hair tied loosely, wearing an elegant deep-sea navy coat trimmed with brass, with a pocket watch hanging from a chain that radiates light. She gently placed a glowing book on a floating base, as if unlocking a hidden story in the universe. Around her is a miniature handmade version of herself playing different roles: one deciphering ancient runes on a floating stele, another piloting a miniature airship made of parchment and gears, one drawing constellations on an unfolded star chart, and another repairing a mechanical owl made from layered paper and copper textures. The environment is a vast, dreamlike library, composed of stacked floating books, a spiral staircase dissolving in starlight, and glowing knowledge spheres suspended in midair. The background gradually fades into deep indigo space, filled with subtle nebular clusters and golden constellations forming abstract maps. The entire artwork features a sophisticated handcrafted paper sculpture aesthetic, featuring layered paper edges, soft cinematic edge lighting, intricate shadow depths, and a rich color scheme of midnight blue, antique gold, luminous cyan, and parchment beige. The atmosphere feels mysterious, rational, and grand—like a secret archive of the universe.

High-detail macro photography look, saturated jewel tones, warm highlights, dark vignette edges, no people except miniature statues or landmark replicas.

Each title appears in elegant white serif uppercase lettering near the upper-left of its panel, with “MINI” smaller where appropriate. Keep the labels readable and spelled exactly.

Top-right “MINI LONDON” shows edible London landmarks on golden sugar terrain with a small river or lagoon in front: Tower Bridge made from orange biscuit/candy, a Big Ben/Elizabeth Tower-style clock tower, the tall Shard-shaped sugar-glass tower, the Gherkin with diamond icing pattern, red-orange skyscrapers, tiny trees, and moody night sky with pink and red bokeh lights. Bottom-left “MINI BEIJING” shows a miniature Beijing foodscape with a grand circular Temple of Heaven-style structure, ornate red-and-gold palace roofs, pagoda-like towers, a CCTV Headquarters-style angular building in the background, a red Chinese gate bridge over blue water in the foreground, lush edible greenery, sugar dunes, mist, and warm lantern-like glow. description.en: A glossy Cuban salsa box-garden filled with dancers, records, plants, travel keepsakes, and playful ceramic details.

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a glossy miniature 3D diorama, like a handcrafted ceramic toy “box garden,” filled with salsa dancing, Cuban travel, music, plants, and colorful personal-favorite objects.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, front-facing three-quarter view of a small white corner room on a white base, photographed like a high-end product shot against a clean pale background. Use soft studio lighting, crisp focus, bright saturated colors, shiny enamel/plastic/ceramic textures, and charming miniature scale.

Main subject: In the center, place exactly 2 salsa dancers: a woman in a flowing glossy {argument name="dress color" default="red"} salsa dress with matching heels, hair in a bun with red flowers, and a man in a shiny black suit with a red shirt and black fedora. They are mid-dance in a dramatic close embrace, one arm raised, posed on a small round patterned rug.

Room layout and counted objects: Build a cozy L-shaped corner room with exactly 2 white walls and 1 white floor base. Include exactly 1 blue shuttered window on the left wall with flower boxes. Include exactly 1 black wall lantern, exactly 1 framed tropical beach picture, exactly 1 small chalkboard sign reading “¡BAILA!” with a heart, exactly 1 blue folding chair, exactly 1 round blue café table, exactly 1 white coffee cup on a saucer, and exactly 1 yellow potted pink flower on or beside the table. On the back wall, hang exactly 1 clothesline with exactly 5 clipped travel photos/postcards, including one that reads “CUBA.” Add exactly 1 large yellow poster on the right back wall reading “SALSA” with silhouettes of dancers and the word “LIVE” near the bottom.

Music and dance details: At the front left, include exactly 1 black DJ controller/turntable console with exactly 2 visible vinyl records, one red-centered and one blue-centered. Near the front center, place exactly 1 glossy black cat figurine with bright yellow eyes, sitting beside exactly 2 golden music notes and exactly 1 black maraca-like handheld instrument. Keep the vibe playful and musical, like a tiny salsa party scene.

Bookshelves and decor: On the right wall, place exactly 1 blue bookshelf with exactly 2 shelves of colorful books and small decorative items. Put exactly 3 potted plants on top of the shelf: one yellow pot with green cactus and pink flower, one red mug-shaped pot with yellow flowers, and one small green pot. Include another shelf section with books and a small face-like pot. In the room overall, include exactly 9 visible potted plants or succulent arrangements: the yellow pink-flower pot near the café table, a green plant near the dancers, a pink succulent, a red cactus pot on the back shelf, a green succulent mound behind the dancers, a yellow pot with small plant near the stereo shelf, the yellow cactus pot on the bookshelf, the red mug flower pot on the bookshelf, and a large red pot with leafy green plant at the front right.

Travel and beach details: At the front right, add exactly 1 small toy sailboat with a blue triangular sail, white triangular sail, brown mast, and white hull, floating on exactly 1 stylized blue wavy water base. Near the lower right foreground, place exactly 1 fan of color swatches containing many rainbow rectangles and exactly 1 black pen or marker laid across it.

Use a cheerful palette dominated by red, blue, yellow, green, and white. Ensure the scene feels packed but organized, with no human-scale realism, no blur, no dark mood, no extra text beyond the visible signs and posters, and no watermark.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for cinematic 3d typography art, with clear composition, material, lighting, and art-direction cues.

entries.prompt: Create a clean 2x2 grid of four front-facing 3D typographic sculptures on a light gray seamless studio background, separated by thin white dividers. Each quadrant features a single giant letter built entirely from dense, realistic filmmaking equipment and on-set props from a different cinematic era, with the letterform chaotic but clearly legible. Use high-end Cinema 4D product-render aesthetics, ambient occlusion, realistic scale relationships, intricate kit-bashing, subtle wear, metallic reflections, and three-point studio lighting with a soft overhead source. Top-left: the letter S, representing early silent-era or proto-cinema filmmaking, constructed from antique brass-and-wood cameras, exposed gears, film reels, projector parts, bellows, tripod wood legs, and vintage optical housings; warm bronze and copper tones; include 3 extra props at the base: a black megaphone labeled "DIRECTOR", a clapboard, and a short stack of film canisters; one projector-like lens at the upper right glows brightly. Top-right: the letter C, representing classical Hollywood film production, built from black metal film cameras, studio lenses, magazines, matte boxes, dolly components, control boxes, and analog set hardware; mostly black, steel, and gunmetal with subtle brass accents; include 4 extra props integrated around the base and inner right side: a clapperboard, a boxy side module, a film magazine marked "35", and a small cylindrical canister; a large forward-facing lamp or lens glows at the upper right. Bottom-left: the letter N, representing modern analog or late-20th-century cinema, assembled from Arriflex-style cameras, long cine zoom lenses, support rigs, rails, cables, a slate, and a field recorder; predominantly matte black with silver hardware and a few red accent rings; include 3 clearly visible base elements: a clapperboard section, a labeled director strip, and a rectangular audio recorder/control unit at the bottom. Bottom-right: the letter D, representing digital and virtual production, built from RED-style digital cinema cameras, monitors, battery packs, wireless transmitters, drones, LED panels, green-screen fabric inserts, and modular rig components; black technical bodies with vivid green accents and screen graphics; include 4 notable integrated device types: drone arms/propellers at the top, a rectangular LED light panel, multiple monitors, and a large camera lens at the lower left. Keep all objects grounded and physically connected, no floating pieces, no flat typography, no handwriting, no paper look, no messy background. Ultra-detailed, sharp, 8k, polished graphic design asset for a poster or visual comparison of filmmaking eras.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for hand-drawn travel doodle art, with clear composition, material, lighting, and art-direction cues.

entries.prompt: Create a charming editorial-style travel illustration for {DESTINATION}, using a minimalist hand-drawn doodle style, as if it were hand-drawn in a travel notebook with a black felt-tip pen. Illustrations should feel very personal, spontaneous, and imperfect, not digital designs. Imagine someone sitting in a café after visiting a destination, casually creating a painting. ## Color Combinations Keep the illustration almost entirely black and white. Use only one accent color: {ONE POINT COLOR} ## Style Drawn entirely with black felt-tip pen lines. Using slightly shaky hand-drawn outlines, natural line variations, loose marker strokes, sketch-like confidence, subtle imperfections, slightly open line ends, uneven hand pressure, and occasional overlapping brushstrokes. Every line should clearly appear handmade. Avoid perfectly smooth curves, mechanically precise contours, refined vector graphics, or overly sharp digital renderings. ## Theme Depicts {DESTINATION}'s unique atmosphere and highly recognizable identity, rather than creating realistic cityscapes. Choose the destination's most iconic landmarks, unique architecture, local transportation, famous scenery, native plants, local animals, regional cuisine, and cultural items. Focus on the spirit of the destination, not on literal accuracy. ## Composition Arrange selected elements into a balanced editing composition with plenty of empty space. The layout should feel open, light, and effortless, similar to a designer's travel sketchbook. Allows objects to naturally overlap without becoming crowded. Each element should have room to breathe. Keep the composition visually relaxed and not messy. Apply a small amount of blue to selected details such as water, sky, windows, signs, clothing accents, decorative highlights, or small architectural features. Never introduce any other colors. ## Painting Style Keep each object simple and deliberately simplified. Uses a flat shape with minimal internal details. Avoid realistic textures, gradients, shadows, painterly brush techniques, glossy surfaces, or complex rendering. Illustrations should remain clean, grand, understated, and highly flat. ## Line Quality The lines of the black marker pen are the main visual feature. Lines should feel confident, casual, lively, expressive, and naturally imperfect. Slightly uneven outlines, openings at the edges, varying line thickness, and tiny drawing errors are encouraged, as they enhance the authentic hand-drawn feel. ## Atmosphere Warm. Friendly. Relax. Playful. Minimalist. Editorial style. Contemporary Sensibility. Express elegance through simplicity. Finished artwork should resemble beautifully designed travel notebooks, boutique travel guides, editorial magazine illustrations, or lifestyle sketchbooks, rather than elaborate digital illustrations. ## Important Points Do not photograph realistically. No 3D rendering. Don't paint the effects. Don't make a gradual change. Don't double the shadows. Do not use glossy lighting. Don't create a neat artwork that feels like a vector. Don't go into too many details. Don't make the composition crowded. Leaving a lot of blank space. Maintains a flat edited graffiti aesthetic with distinct handmade characteristics. The final image should instantly evoke memories of {DESTINATION} through simple, expressive black felt-tip sketches and subtle sky-blue accents.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for seaside wedding invitation visual, with clear composition, lighting, and art-direction cues.

entries.prompt:
Generate a ritual invitation visual around a specific theme: the image is first visually dominated by an oversized handwritten main title, with thick white brushstrokes, slightly rough edges, and a sense of speed. Long horizontal and dropping strokes cross the background space, as if directly writing emotions into the scene; Below it lies an open, quiet, and breathable thematic field, with clear horizontal layers in the distance, and a central axis leading into the depths or a visual guideline. In the middle, a cleanly bounded rectangular image layer is embedded, where the content and the main narrative form a retrospective of time or memory, like a fragment placed within a real-life scene; Below, smaller thematic figures, objects, or symbolic figures enter the frame from behind, serving as entry points for scale and narrative. Keep the text restrained: use fine text in the upper right to arrange time and place information, with short lines or arrows to pause reading; use elegant serif or fine font, thin horizontal lines, and name/subject names at the bottom to create a ceremonial feel. The text is not an explanation board but works together with the images to form a rhythm. Colors are drawn from the theme's own environment, materials, seasons, and moods, preserving large areas of clear low-saturation backgrounds, a small amount of high-brightness white writing, clear dark structures, and local temperature differences, resulting in an overall clarity and quietness with a sense of calm and airiness. Even if the subject requires darker colors, keep the gradations clean, edges clear, and transparent layers to avoid muddy aging. The final texture is like a real photographic fusion with handwritten calligraphy, with clear layers, breathable blank spaces, and a strong sense of ceremony. At first glance, one senses the powerful emotion of handwriting; the second glance enters the central image and the narrative below.

——————
Image direction: Seaside wedding invitations, preserving the ritual of distant sea, shore passages to the depths, and handwritten welcome messages
For posting on Moments: wedding previews and guest invitations, with information kept in three categories: time, location, and name
Size: Vertical 3:4, with the middle photo layer replaced by a memory of the newlyweds holding hands as they walk toward the seaside

entries.prompt:

Stage 1: Observation & Morphological Analysis The goal is to deconstruct the image of the crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the primary "valley" and "ridge" lines. These represent potential structural ribs or seams in the chair. Faceted Planes: Break down the sphere into a series of non-uniform polygons. Each flat surface of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the "tossed" form creates deep recesses. These natural pockets guide where the user’s weight will be cradled.

Stage 2: Iterative Form Exploration Moving from a sphere to a seat through "Digital Crumpling." Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper ball as a solid mass. Use Boolean operations to "carve out" a seating cavity that fits the human form while maintaining the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (like Rhino or Blender) to simulate a flat sheet of material being compressed. This ensures the folds look authentic and not "modeled." The "Toss" Logic: Experiment with gravity-based simulation dropping a digital mesh to see how it settles naturally, mimicking the "tossed" origin.

Stage 3: Ergonomic Translation & Blueprinting Refining the raw aesthetic into a functional object. The Comfort Core: Overlay a standard ergonomic template (Seating Angle: 105°–110°) over the crumpled form. Adjust the internal "folds" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Create technical orthographic views (Front, Side, Top). Map out the dimensions: Seat Height: 450mm Total Width: 850mm Surface Smoothing: Maintain the sharp "paper edges" on the exterior shell while softening the interior contact points for skin comfort.

Stage 4: Structural Integration & Scaling Making the concept physically viable. The Skeleton: Design a hidden internal frame (likely CNC-bent steel rods or a 3D-printed lattice) that follows the most prominent ridges of the paper folds to provide rigidity. Material Selection: * Option A (High-End): Faceted, cast aluminum with a white powder coat. Option B (Soft): Vacuum-formed recycled plastic shell covered in "memory-fold" technical fabric that retains a wrinkled appearance.

Stage 5: Final Prototyping & Material Finish Textural Replication: Apply a matte, slightly porous finish to the material to mimic the tactile feel of heavy-bond paper. Lighting Contrast: Use directional studio lighting in the final renders to emphasize the "tossed" shadows, making the chair look like a giant piece of discarded inspiration. Design Tip: To keep the "tossed" look authentic, avoid symmetry. The most compelling aspect of a crumpled paper ball is its unique irregularity—ensure the left and right sides of the chair are balance-equivalent but not identical

entries.prompt:
Pastel paper collage style character prompts

Creating a refined wide-format Pakistani landscape illustration, naturally using the Faisal Mosque as the main visual anchor.

Core style:
Portraying Pakistan as a tranquil, elegant, and highly stylized scene using a soft-toned pastel paper collage poster style. Scenes should be minimalist, clean, poetic, modern, humanistic, relaxed, and cheerful, rather than realistic in style.

Composition:
Use a broad horizontal composition. The Faisal Mosque is the focal point, clearly distinguished by its iconic triangular tented architecture and the minarets rising above layered landscapes. Surrounded by the Malgara Mountains, the Khunza Valley mountain range, silhouettes of the Bad Shahi Mosque, elements of Lahore forts, traditional villages, winding rivers, terraced fields, and simplified expressions of regional cultural details. Using clean geometric shapes, layered color planes, soft curves, clear silhouettes, and paper-like cutouts, everything is reinterpreted into highly stylized illustration forms. Avoid realism.

Visual Elements:
It features minimalist yet charming details: tiny figures strolling, cyclists, traditional market scenes, brightly colored trucks, boats on the Indus River, flowering trees, grazing animals, and tiny buildings inspired by different regions of Pakistan. Use a calm, open sky, leave plenty of breathing room, and employ clear horizontal layering to suggest depth and atmosphere.

Palette (Elegant Pastels):
Soft sky blue, hazy blue-gray, light cobalt blue, delicate sage green, powdered mint green, warm cream, light beige, light lime, gray coral, soft peach, pale yellow, milky white, accented with emerald green, turquoise, terracotta, and deep navy inspired by Pakistani art, textiles, and landscapes.

Tactile Quality:
The images should have a tactile and handmade feel, like carefully arranged colored paper and gouache poster boards. Subtle paper textures, matte printed textures, soft raised edges, delicate embossing, slight paper-cut shadows, and a gentle surface roughness are added. Keep the surface refined and simple, without clutter.

Visual Language:
Minimalist paper collages, pastel travel posters, flat geometric shapes, subtle 3D paper reliefs, clear silhouettes, simplified architecture, soft matte textures, crisp color gamut, soft shadows, minimalist lines, exquisite editorial illustrations, and the atmosphere of modern South Asian cultural posters. Wide format format, balanced negative space, strong graphic layering, clear focal areas, harmoniously arranged simplified areas, transparency, calmness, and visual comfort.

Light and Atmosphere
Bright, soft daylight, a clean atmosphere, gentle shadows, warm and relaxed tones, a cultured and optimistic mood, and a quiet yet refined travel poster feel.

Layout (top left):
The main title "PAKISTAN" uses geometric uppercase sans-serif font, wide spacing, and pure white. Below: The smaller native script "پاکستان · Pakistan" and the English subtitle "Faisal Mosque & Northern Landscapes" are all in matching white, aligned to the left, with fine lines and spacing of the characters.

Avoid:
Realism, realistic photography, overly detailed architecture, heavy contours, messy brushstrokes, neon cyberpunk style, dark and dull lighting effects, excessive gradients, crowded scenes, readable signs, logos, watermarks.

Final Result:
A beautifully polished minimalist pastel paper collage of Pakistani landscape illustrations, with the Faisal Mosque as the main visual anchor, featuring tactile paper textures, soft shadows, clean geometric color blocks, ample blank space, and a refined modern tourism illustration atmosphere celebrating the country's natural beauty, cultural heritage, mountains, rivers, and iconic buildings.

[The Second Character]
An adult young man, [blurred profile in the foreground / blurred outline in the background / reflection of a person / a nearby figure with blurred movement], wearing dark clothing. He should exist as an emotional entity, not as a clear second main subject.

Very important: use layered focus, not global blur.

Shot 11 (10:00–11:00s) – Close-up, high angle: Her hands elegantly use a spoon to ladle perfectly cooked dishes (glossy stir-fried beef, vibrant vegetables, rich sauces) from the pan to plate.

entries.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium conceptual typography poster for the exact title:

“[INPUT_TEXT]”

Single poster only. No moodboard, grid, presentation board, mockup, captions, prompt text, process sheet, or sample labels.

The title “[INPUT_TEXT]” must be the dominant visual structure of the poster: huge, readable, powerful, and spelled exactly. Do not translate, shorten, replace, or misspell it. Do not add other large readable text. Optional micro catalog text is allowed only if it stays subtle and secondary.

Silently interpret the title’s meaning, mood, cultural aura, symbolic associations, psychological tension, and visual rhythm. Turn that interpretation into one strong visual metaphor.

Typography is the hero. Design custom-looking letterforms whose weight, width, contrast, spacing, rhythm, distortion, negative space, edge quality, and ink texture express the temperament of the title. The type should feel intentionally designed, not like a default font.

For all other titles, use a human figure, landscape, object, or atmospheric setting only when it strengthens the meaning. It must interact with the typography and deepen the concept, not decorate it.

Use a rich but restrained 4–6 color system matched to the theme: dominant background color, primary typography color, figure / landscape tone, emotional accent color, muted support color, and subtle paper / ink texture tone. Avoid flat black-white-red defaults unless conceptually necessary.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for rosemary Chronicle: Twelve Stages, with clear composition, lighting, and art-direction cues.

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage botanical photo-chronicle contact sheet titled {argument name="headline text" default="The Slow Garden: A Rosemary Chronicle"}, documenting the life cycle of {argument name="plant name" default="rosemary"} from dry pot to harvest.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster on warm aged parchment paper, subtle stains and speckles, soft cream background, thin dark-green panel borders, handwritten field-journal typography. Use a large decorative serif/calligraphy headline centered at the top.

Layout: Arrange exactly 12 photographic panels in a clean 4-column by 3-row grid. Each panel has a handwritten green stage label above it, a short uppercase camera-direction caption below it, and an italic poetic quote beneath the caption. Add small downward arrow marks along the far left and far right margins to suggest time passing.

Panel details, count exactly 12:
1. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: a terracotta pot on a windowsill filled with cracked dry soil, no plant visible. Caption: "WIDE · OVERHEAD · FIXED CAMERA". Quote: "Winter's silence, the seed waits."
2. Stage label: "Dormancy". Image: macro view of a terracotta pot rim and dark soil with a single water droplet running down the clay side. Caption: "MACRO · SLOW MOTION DROP". Quote: "First drop, awakening memory."
3. Stage label: "Germination". Image: low-angle close photo of a pale tiny shoot emerging from dark soil. Caption: "LOW ANGLE · TIME-LAPSE FEEL". Quote: "Root first, shoot later."
4. Stage label: "Germination". Image: close-up of a small cotyledon seedling with two green leaves rising from soil, soft bokeh background. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · COTYLEDON FOCUS". Quote: "Breaking ground, it took seven days."
5. Stage label: "Growth". Image: macro of young rosemary leaves with rim light, dew-like texture on needle edges. Caption: "MACRO · LEAF EDGE RIM LIGHT". Quote: "Every leaf, a map of aroma."
6. Stage label: "Growth". Image: close-up of a human fingertip gently touching a tender rosemary sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · FINGERTIP CONTACT". Quote: "A gentle touch, handful of fragrance."
7. Stage label: "Growth". Image: overhead photo of a woody rosemary branch with green branching needles. Caption: "OVERHEAD · BRANCHING STRUCTURE". Quote: "One year bone, two years flesh."
8. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: medium shot of a rosemary plant in a terracotta pot with small purple-blue flowers and a bee approaching or hovering near the blooms. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · BEE ENTRANCE". Quote: "When flowers open, the whole garden arrives."
9. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: wide shot of rosemary on a rustic wooden surface in golden sunlight, strong leaf shadows across the boards. Caption: "WIDE · LIGHT & SHADOW CONTRAST". Quote: "Dialogue of light and leaf, repeated daily."
10. Stage label: "Flourishing". Image: close-up of pruning shears cutting a rosemary stem while a hand holds the sprig. Caption: "CLOSE-UP · SCISSORS & STEM". Quote: "Pruning is not an end, it's another beginning."
11. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: medium shot of a bundled rosemary bunch hanging upside down in a rustic shed or wooden room to dry. Caption: "MEDIUM SHOT · HANGING DRY". Quote: "Drying time, leave it to the wind."
12. Stage label: "Harvesting". Image: wide still-life composition with dried rosemary spilling from a small linen drawstring pouch beside a terracotta pot. Caption: "WIDE · STILL LIFE COMPOSITION". Quote: "Aroma sealed, awaiting the next awakening."

Visual style: Photorealistic macro garden photography mixed with hand-crafted editorial scrapbook design, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, earthy terracotta browns, rosemary greens, muted purple blossoms, warm sunlight, gentle film grain, slightly imperfect handwritten annotations.

Constraints: Keep the grid aligned and readable, use exactly 12 panels and no extra panels, avoid modern UI elements, avoid watermarks, avoid logos, preserve the vintage botanical journal feeling. Make all visible text legible and in English.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for city Lovers Watercolor Travel Poster, with clear composition, lighting, and art-direction cues.

entries.prompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical scale watercolor urban sketch travel poster on textured handmade watercolor paper.

City Input:
[City Name]

Create a romantic everyday scene that reflects [City Name]'s authentic architecture, landmarks, street life, climate, and cultural atmosphere. Use identifiable city-specific elements such as local buildings, cafes, balconies, canals, bridges, trams, towers, rooftops, tiles, waterfronts, street facilities, plants, or signage. Avoid generic European landscapes or the wrong landmarks.

Main Scene:
The two lovers are shown as the main subjects, positioned slightly below the center. They might be taking a walk, sitting in an outdoor café, sharing iced coffee, standing by the water, admiring the scenery, or gently holding hands. Their poses should feel natural, affectionate, quiet, and unstaged. Don't just show one person.

Roles:
Dress the couple in stylish casual summer outfits suitable for [City Name]: linen shirts, light cardigan, casual pants, summer dresses, sneakers, sandals, sunglasses, crossbody bags, handbags, cameras, pastries, or chilled drinks. The clothing colors are mainly white, light blue, aqua blue, and soft gray-blue, accented with one or two pieces of lemon yellow. Add a gentle breeze to your hair and loose fabrics.

Composition:
It uses a clean vertical poster layout, leaving plenty of negative space and a transparent editorial feel. Keep the couple's ratio small to medium, surrounded by the architecture or scenery of a specific city. Place buildings and landmarks in the background or sides, softly blending into the paper texture. The upper half remains bright and open, with the upper right reserved for typography.

Layout:
In the upper right corner, add the city name in elegant italic English:
"[CITY NAME]"

Next, add a short poetic English sentence that fits the fresh summer vibe of the city. Use delicate and soft cobalt blue, gray blue, or serene navy blue fonts. Keep it minimalist, clear, and blend naturally into the paper.

Color direction:
Use fresh blue-yellow summer tones:

75% cool blue and blue-gray: sky blue, cyan, freshwater blue, pale blue, faded turquoise, soft blue-gray, and localized cobalt blue.

15% clean white and warm white paper highlights.

10% pale lemon yellow, soft cream yellow, sun-kissed milky white, or light golden accents.

Blue should dominate, while yellow adds warmth and visual rhythm. Yellow is used only on canopies, window lights, flowers, umbrellas, pastries, signs, clothing details, beverage labels, or sunlit building edges. Avoid a completely blue flat background.

Watercolor techniques:
Uses semi-transparent gradation, soft blue washing, subtle pigment grains, wet painting textures, soft brushstroke renderings, light shading, clearly visible handmade paper textures, slight splashes, and just the right subtle reflections. Yellow grading should feel like light touching paper.

Painting details:
Delicate ink lines are used, with a slightly imperfect hand-drawn line feel. Add refined urban sketch details: windows, blinds, balconies, streetlights, coffee chairs, paving stones, railings, plants, folds, hair, hands, shoes, bags, cups, signs, and soft ground marks. Keep the face soft and gestury, without pursuing realism.

Atmosphere and Quality:
Minimalist watercolor urban sketch, romantic summer travel poster, quiet love story, city-specific atmosphere, refreshing blue tones with lemon yellow highlights, elegant fashion illustrations, cozy moments of life, soft Japanese style, sophisticated editorial look, calm pastel ambiance, soft natural light, clean background, poster ready, 8K.

Negative prompt:
Single-player, universal city, wrong landmarks, all-blue background, monochrome blue, lifeless colors, yellow dominates, orange heavy, brown dominates, dark retro tones, muddy beige, neon colors, oversaturated colors, photo realism, 3D rendering, heavy contours, stiff shadows, crowded streets, messy backgrounds, realistic faces, stiff postures, awkward anatomical structures, smooth textures, bold fonts.

On the left, a large Japanese tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="物語の続きを、いちばん近くで。"} with a thin vertical red line and a small descriptive paragraph. On the right, place exactly 3 article cards in a row. The 3 cards are: 1) 「月蝕綺譚 最新便」 with a moon image, a small red NEW label, title 「大型アップデート『○○』を公開しました」, date 2024.05.20; 2) 「開発記録」 with a notebook and pen image, title 「開発記録 #12：環境音の調整について」, date 2024.05.18; 3) 「ご意見箱」 with a dark mailbox image, title 「ご意見・ご感想をお聞かせください」, date 2024.05.16. Each card has a thin border, a small arrow in the header, and gray placeholder summary lines.

Desktop footer: Add a dark navy footer spanning the bottom with exactly 6 footer links: 「お知らせ」, 「開発記録」, 「ご意見箱」, 「アーカイブ」, 「利用規約」, 「プライバシーポリシー」. Include a crescent moon icon and copyright 「© 2024 月蝕綺譚」 on the right.

Mobile layout: On the right smartphone, show the same site adapted to mobile. Status bar time reads 9:41. Header contains the title 「月蝕綺譚」 and a hamburger menu icon. Below it, show a compact dark hero with the eclipse and vertical title, then exactly 5 small horizontal thumbnails. Continue with the tagline 「物語の続きを、いちばん近くで。」, then the same ticket-shaped email signup card, then the first news card 「月蝕綺譚 最新便」 with moon image and red NEW label. The mobile view should be vertically scrollable-looking but contained within the phone screen.

Constraints: Keep all visible interface text in Japanese as specified. Use clean, high-fidelity UI mockup rendering, crisp typography, subtle shadows, and no extra logos or watermarks. The design should look like a finished web/app mock generated for implementation planning.

entries.prompt:
主題：
{argument name="主題" default="七夕"}

人物・表情：
{argument name="年代" default="20代"}女性。やわらかい卵型の顔立ち、透明感のある自然な肌、控えめな日式メイク。暗めのブラウンヘアを低めのゆるいまとめ髪にし、後れ毛が朝の光で細く透ける。小さな紫系の髪飾りを耳の後ろに添える。顔は少し上向き、視線は右上の短冊へ向け、静かに願いを結ぶような穏やかな表情。

服装・ポーズ：
{argument name="衣服" default="白地に青い花柄の浴衣"}、濃紺の帯。浴衣の袖は自然にたわみ、布の透け感とシワを丁寧に表現する。体は画面右上へ軽く伸びる姿勢。人物自身の右腕を高く上げ、画面右上のピンクの短冊にそっと触れる。人物自身の左腕は体の近くに自然に下ろし、腰まわりの帯と浴衣の重なりが見える。指先は力を入れすぎず、短冊をつまむ直前の繊細な動き。

背景・光：
日本の七夕飾りが並ぶ朝の神社参道または商店街の一角。頭上には笹の葉と色とりどりの短冊が重なり、ピンク、黄色、水色、薄紫の紙が朝風で軽く揺れている。背景にはぼんやりした提灯と屋台の気配を残すが、夜ではなく明るい朝。主光源は画面左上奥から差し込む低めの朝日。人物の髪の縁、頬、肩、上げた腕に強めの白いハイライトを作り、背景は淡い緑と白のボケで明るく抜ける。短冊と笹の影が浴衣や肌に薄く落ちる。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図。上半身中心のポートレートで、人物は画面下中央から右寄りに配置し、上部に短冊と笹の飾りを大きく入れる。カメラは胸の高さより少し低め、人物を見上げるような軽いローアングル。35mm相当の自然な広がり、人物と短冊の距離感が伝わる構図。ピントは人物の顔と右手の指先、背景の提灯や奥の参道は浅めの被写界深度で柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
実写写真風。朝の逆光を活かした明るいハイキー寄りのポートレート。肌は過度に磨かず、自然な毛穴、細い髪の乱れ、浴衣の綿素材、短冊の紙の薄さを残す。透明感のある白と淡い緑、浴衣の青を中心に、夏の朝らしい軽い色調。フィルム写真のような柔らかい粒子と自然なレンズフレアを少量入れる。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、余分または欠けた指、手首や肘の破綻、短冊との接触不良、浴衣の構造崩れ、帯の位置ずれ、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、読めすぎる不自然な文字、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、不要な人物、過剰な露出、背景と矛盾する影。

entries.prompt: 围绕{argument name="主题" default="早安+问候+GOOD MORNING+城市+金句+天气+2026-08-10"}生成具有平面海报秩序与真实焦点形象的设计：先以一块占据上部的大面积鲜明高明度色场建立开阔留白，再在下部接入一块近乎等量、低饱和的浅色纸面区域，形成干净明确的水平色域交界；让主题的核心形态被转译成两组超大、低细节、厚重圆润的浅色字符化图形，横跨交界线并向左右边缘出血，保留清晰的内部空腔、粗细对比与被边界裁断的切口，图形不是装饰而是背景中的尺度标尺和视觉骨架。把主题主体或核心对象压缩为中小尺度的具象焦点，放在交界附近，局部遮挡巨型图形，使前景对象、图形轮廓与留白发生明确的前后穿插；焦点对象以自然摄影或高度具象的质感表现，保留真实表面细节、柔和的侧上方光线、接地的短而松散的投影，以及不喧宾夺主的中性深色层次。左侧靠近交界的区域放置主题相关的两行短标题，使用粗重、紧凑、几何感明确的无衬线大写字形，行距偏紧、字块整齐左对齐，以黑色或主题最深结构色形成小面积强锚点；在巨型图形上缘两侧加入极小号、宽字距的元信息与编号式短标签，形成稀疏的编辑设计节奏，但文字只承担秩序、尺度和信息提示，不复制固定文案。颜色由主题语义决定色相与材质来源，但维持高明度高纯度主色场对柔和浅底的面积、明度、饱和度和情绪张力关系，巨型图形使用比浅底更醒目或更中性的浅色，深色文字与焦点阴影只占少量；主题色温改变时仍保持大色块对比、清洁边界和有限强调色，不把颜色平均铺满。整体像在哑光纸上进行干净的平面印刷，纸张有细微均匀纤维与颗粒，浅底和色场存在轻微密度不匀，实拍对象边缘与印刷图形边缘清楚但不过度锐利，色块交界保持利落，避免厚重做旧、泛黄、脏污、额外装饰和现代渐变；让背景留白、巨型图形、短标题、微型标签、焦点对象和接地阴影共同形成从大色场到文字再到主体的阅读路径，若去掉图形遮挡、色域交界或尺度反差，画面应立即失去这种克制而有张力的设计识别度。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for tang Dynasty Four Scenes Portrait, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
面部身份：
使用附带的面部身份作为唯一面部参考。四张照片始终匹配相同的五官比例、肤色、年龄感与整体身份。

身体：
{argument name="人物年龄" default="20岁出头的成年女性"}。使用附带的身体参考作为唯一身体比例参考，保持真实解剖结构、自然曲线与皮肤纹理。
主题：
{argument name="主题场景" default="盛唐娱乐四景"}：曲江斗花、长安酒肆、乐坊舞毕、马球赛后。

主体：
分别生成四张独立的纵向2:3彩色写实照片，不要拼图。四张保持同一人物，但根据活动更换符合盛唐审美的发型、服装、表情和摄影语言。

第一张「花隙里的胜负揭晓」：
曲江斗花会刚揭晓结果。镜头隔着牡丹与彩幄拍摄人物大特写。她梳盛唐半翻髻，佩戴不对称簪花，穿浅杏白、石青与牡丹红组成的现代审美唐风齐胸襦裙。她循声转向朋友，眉梢轻抬，笑意刚刚出现。采用100–135mm远距观察、前景遮挡和低反差彩色负片质感。

第二张「长安酒肆第七轮」：
人物坐在胡姬酒肆的低案旁，刚放下鎏金耳杯便被同席朋友逗笑。乌发梳成乌蛮髻，穿孔雀蓝织锦内层、朱红半臂衣与深绯罗裙。采用35mm同席纪实视角，桌缘、胡瓶与宾客肩背自然进入前景。暖灯完整覆盖五官，背景人物分别投筹、交谈与听乐，不统一看镜头。

第三张「乐坊舞毕后的彩色余息」：
最后一支舞结束，人物在乐坊侧室罗帘旁停步调整呼吸。头发梳成唐代舞后高髻，一束发丝略微松散。暗红与孔雀绿舞衣采用不透明内层，披帛和袖缘保留轻盈层次。她循声望向帘外，嘴唇轻启，疲惫、满足与意外同时存在。采用50mm后台近景、柔雾彩色负片、暗红与灰蓝空间分层。

第四张「马球越线后的回身」：
盛唐女骑手下马后快步走向休息区，听见同伴呼喊便在步伐中回身。头发梳成左右清晰的双螺骑装髻，穿暗红内层、石青窄袖袍、深色分裁裙裤与皮革长靴。仅保留一只手握住从画面下缘进入的球杖杆身，另一只手不入镜。采用135mm长焦、约1/40秒彩色慢门追随，主体脸部清楚，马匹、旗幡与扬尘形成方向性色带。

光线：
四张均以宽面自然光或有罩室内灯连续照亮五官。环境色和灯笼只服务空间层次，不在脸部形成圆形光斑、碎光、花影或局部漂白。

质感：
真实彩色摄影，保留毛孔、细绒毛、自然血色、衣料重量和轻微胶片颗粒。借鉴经典彩色纪实、柔雾时装与运动摄影的画面组织方法，但不复制具体作品。拒绝黑白、近黑白和统一暖金商业滤镜。
画面右下角加入低调小号手写签名「{argument name="签名" default="Zhong"}」。

负面提示：
拼图，多分镜，人物身份漂移，现代马尾，泛古风头冠，廉价影楼古装，统一摆拍表情，背景人物动作重复，复杂手势，双手承担多个动作，多余手臂，多余手指，错误手指，脸部光斑，彩色投影，塑料皮肤，黑白照片，现代场景，乱码文字，其他签名。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for premium Mixed Media Ad, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]
[HERO PRODUCT]
[PRODUCT ARRANGEMENT]
[ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER]
[CHARACTER ACTION]
[PRIMARY HEADLINE]
[SUPPORTING LINE]
[COLOR PALETTE]
[ILLUSTRATION COLOR]
[BACKGROUND COLOR]
[GRAPHIC MOTIF]
[IMAGE RATIO]

Create a premium mixed-media product advertisement in [IMAGE RATIO], combining photorealistic commercial product photography with one original hand-drawn editorial character.

If a product image is provided, preserve its shape, proportions, colors, materials, textures, packaging, labels, logo placement, and distinctive details. Remove the original background without redesigning the product.

If a person's photo is provided, preserve their recognizable features while translating them into a simplified editorial line illustration.

If no references are provided, generate [HERO PRODUCT] and [ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER] from the written specifications.

Create an original campaign for "{argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}" featuring {argument name="hero product" default="[HERO PRODUCT]"} as the hero object. Introduce [ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER] performing [CHARACTER ACTION] naturally on, beside, or around the product.

Use a minimal asymmetrical composition with generous negative space. Place [HERO PRODUCT] in the lower-center foreground using [PRODUCT ARRANGEMENT], occupying approximately 40–55% of the canvas. Position the illustrated character interacting naturally with the product.

Use {argument name="background color" default="[BACKGROUND COLOR]"} as the primary background and frame the composition with oversized cropped forms inspired by [GRAPHIC MOTIF].

Render [HERO PRODUCT] with premium commercial realism, preserving realistic textures, highlights, shadows, proportions, and subtle imperfections. Multiple products should vary naturally in angle and position.

Create [ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER] in refined editorial line-art using [ILLUSTRATION COLOR] with subtle fills derived from [COLOR PALETTE]. Ensure anatomically correct interaction with the product.

Write the headline exactly:
"[PRIMARY HEADLINE]"

Write the supporting line exactly:
"[SUPPORTING LINE]"

Display the headline in oversized bold geometric typography, arranged across one or two lines without covering the product. Use coordinated colors from [COLOR PALETTE]. Display the supporting line nearby using a clean sans-serif or subtle italic typeface.

Display the brand name exactly:
"[BRAND NAME]"

Place it subtly within the upper or lower margin. Do not add extra logos, websites, prices, or social media elements unless provided.

Use [GRAPHIC MOTIF] only as cropped edge graphics without intersecting the headline, character, or product.

Apply soft directional studio lighting with realistic tonal depth and grounding shadows. Maintain clear separation between photorealistic and illustrated elements while preserving a unified campaign aesthetic.

Style: Premium mixed-media advertising, photorealistic hero product, editorial hand-drawn character, modern typography, minimal negative-space composition, contemporary lifestyle branding, Behance-quality commercial art direction

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed fantasy RPG character card for {argument name="character name" default="Kris"}, styled like a premium collectible game card from a dark woodland fantasy universe.

Canvas: Vertical portrait card, roughly 4:5 aspect ratio, centered on a black background. The card fills almost the entire canvas and has an ornate carved frame made of dark metal, twisted vines, moss, leaves, branches, and pink-purple forest flowers.

Main subject: A female dryad warlock, half human and half tree spirit, shown from the waist up in a dense enchanted forest. She has glowing green eyes, cracked bark-like olive skin, long tangled dark brown hair mixed with vines and moss, and a crown of leaves and magenta flowers. Her expression is calm, serious, and mystical. She wears organic armor made of bark, roots, leaves, vines, and natural textures, with small glowing green magical accents. Warm sunlight filters through tall trees behind her, creating a dramatic green-gold forest glow.

Card frame and decorative UI: Use a gothic fantasy game-card layout with metallic filigree, curled roots, ivy, moss, and floral ornaments. Include three circular emblems across the top: left circle shows “LVL” above “45”; center small circle shows a glowing green leaf icon; right circle shows a larger green leaf emblem. The border includes many natural decorations, especially vines and exactly 10 prominent pink-purple flowers: 4 clustered near the upper left border, 2 near the upper right border, 1 midway down the left border, 1 midway down the right border, and 2 large flowers at the bottom corners.

Name and class area: Place the large centered name {argument name="character name" default="Kris"} in elegant serif fantasy lettering near the lower middle. Directly beneath it write {argument name="character class" default="WARLOCK"} in spaced green capital letters, flanked by small leaf ornaments. Below that, add a narrow title plaque reading “Dryad • Guardian of the Grove”.

Left stat panel: Add a dark translucent vertical stat box at lower left with exactly 5 rows, each row containing a small colored fantasy icon, a three-letter stat label, and a number. The rows are: STR 38 with a red weapon icon, INT 92 with a green nature icon, WIS 87 with a purple magic icon, DEX 64 with a gold bow icon, CON 76 with a blue endurance icon.

Right stat panel: Add a matching dark translucent vertical stat box at lower right with exactly 5 rows, each row containing a small colored shield/gem icon and a number. The rows are: red HP icon 1,140; blue MP icon 920; gray DEF icon 412; purple RES icon 489; gold SPD icon 72.

Ability panel: At the bottom center, create exactly 4 horizontal ability rows with square icons on the left and text on the right. Row 1: “Grove Ward” with description “Summon vines to shield allies.” Row 2: “Nature’s Grasp” with description “Entangle enemies with ancient roots.” Row 3: “Verdant Renewal” with description “Heal and cleanse allies over time.” Row 4: “Sporebloom” with description “Release toxic spores to weaken foes.” Use glowing green and purple nature-magic icons.

Footer: Add a small centered flavor quote at the very bottom: “✦ Rooted in silence. I rise. ✦” and a small round green leaf medallion beneath it.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed dark fantasy digital painting, cinematic lighting, realistic textures, intricate UI, collectible RPG card design, sharp focus, high contrast, emerald green and warm gold palette with magenta floral accents. Make the typography crisp and readable. Avoid extra characters, extra stat rows, modern logos, watermarks, or misspelled text.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for fingertips Chasing Bubbles In Yukata, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
主題：
泡を追う指先

主体：
縦長3:4の写真。畳敷きの和室に座る一人の女性を画面中央に大きく配置し、頭頂から腰付近までを収める。人物は画面の約75％を占め、両手をカメラへ差し出しながら、目の前を漂うシャボン玉に触れようとしている。

人物・表情：
自然な透明感を持つ女性。髪は濃いダークブラウンの肩につくミディアムボブで、毛先は軽く外側へ動き、薄い前髪が額へ自然に落ちる。顔まわりには細い後れ毛を残す。頭をわずかに傾け、澄んだ瞳でカメラの少し上を見る。唇は軽く開き、静かな驚きと好奇心が混ざった表情。淡いコーラル系メイク、自然な肌理、頬に控えめな血色。

服装・ポーズ：
{argument name="衣装" default="白地に淡い青と桃色の小花を散らした軽やかな浴衣"}。腰には{argument name="帯の色" default="くすんだローズピンクの帯"}。身体は正面を向き、肩の力を抜いて座る。両肘を曲げ、左右の手をレンズ方向へ伸ばし、指を大きく自然に開く。手のひらはやや内側を向き、中央のシャボン玉を包み込もうとする瞬間。手は顔より手前にあり、遠近感によって大きく見える。

背景・光：
左側に木枠の障子、右奥に開いた縁側と緑豊かな庭。畳の左下には青い栓の透明なラムネ瓶を一本置く。大小さまざまなシャボン玉が前景・人物周辺・背景に漂い、表面に虹色の反射が入る。右後方の庭側から暖かな自然光が差し込み、髪の輪郭、頬、肩、手の甲を照らす。障子側は柔らかな影となり、庭の反射光が顔の影を穏やかに持ち上げる。

構図・カメラ：
人物の目線とほぼ同じ高さから撮影した近距離ポートレート。顔に主焦点を置き、手と前景のシャボン玉は軽くぼかす。中央下に両手、その奥に顔を配置した三角形構図。頭上には少量の余白、左右には障子と庭を残す。85mm相当、浅い被写界深度、背景は大きく柔らかな玉ボケ。

質感・スタイル：
夏の午後を感じる日系写真表現。やや暖色寄りの自然な色調、柔らかなコントラスト、繊細なフィルム粒子。肌は過度に加工せず、細かな産毛や光の透過を残す。シャボン玉の薄膜、浴衣の綿の質感、髪の細い一本一本まで自然に描写する。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、左右非対称な瞳、余分な指、欠けた指、指の融合、硬すぎる手、不自然な関節、浴衣の構造破綻、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for serene Cafe Moment With Hat, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
主題：

帽子越しの休息

主体：
{argument name="カフェの雰囲気" default="日本の街角にある落ち着いたカフェ"}で、木製の椅子に座り{argument name="飲み物" default="アイスコーヒー"}を手にする、自然な大人の女性を描いた縦長3:4のリアルなファッションポートレート。人物は画面中央からやや右を大きく占め、頭部から太腿までを収める。テーブルの丸い縁を右下に入れ、窓際の客席と通りの景色を左奥へ続ける。

人物・表情：
{argument name="髪の色" default="黒に近いダークブラウン"}のロングヘア。毛先にはゆるい波があり、頬の横に細い後れ毛を残す。淡いブルーのキャップを深めにかぶり、顔を少し右下へ傾けて飲み物へ視線を落とする。落ち着いた眉、繊細なまつ毛、薄いコーラルチーク、自然な涙袋、ツヤを抑えたローズベージュのリップ。静かで穏やかな表情。

服装・ポーズ：
{argument name="服装" default="白い細リブ素材の半袖クロップドヘンリーネックトップ"}。腰骨の少し上で終わる短い丈で、前ボタンは上部を二つだけ自然に開ける。淡いブルーのハイウエストデニムショートパンツ、小さなシルバーネックレスを合わせる。人物自身の左腕を曲げて手を後頭部へ添え、肘を画面左へ張る。右手は透明なカップの下部を包み、指先を自然に沿わせる。脚は椅子の上で軽く交差させ、身体の重心を右腰側へ預ける。

背景・光：
日本の小さな路面カフェ。右側に濃い木目の収納棚と観葉植物、中央奥に手書き風の日本語メニューがある黒板。左奥には大きな窓、木製カウンター、背を向けて座る客、街路樹とぼかされた車を配置する。午前中の明るい日差しが左上の窓から差し込み、腕、頬、白いトップス、太腿の左側を柔らかく照らす。床には葉の影が落ち、右側には木材からの暖かな反射光を入れる。

構図・カメラ：
縦長3:4、やや高い目線から撮影した腰掛け姿のミディアムショット。人物の顔を上部中央、カップを右下の三分割線付近に置く。キャップ上部には適度な余白を残し、太腿は画面下端で自然に裁切する。35〜50mm相当の自然な遠近感、人物の顔と上半身に焦点を合わせ、背景は内容が分かる程度に穏やかにぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
高性能フルサイズデジタルカメラで撮影した自然なカフェスナップ。細かな髪の毛、コットンリブの凹凸、デニムの色落ち、カップの結露、木目を繊細に描写する。肌は明るく滑らかだが、毛穴や陰影を適度に残す。暖色寄りのナチュラルカラー、控えめなコントラスト、透明感のあるハイライト。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、カップとの接触不良、歪んだ椅子、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、読めない不自然な文字、ブランドロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for intimate Cinematic Couple Skin Portrait, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt: Use the exact same faces from both reference images and generate the most intimately detailed cinematic couple skin portrait ever conceived — two faces impossibly close, the entire frame consumed by the micro-universe of two human faces sharing the same breath. Two faces filling the entire frame together — cheek almost against cheek, foreheads nearly touching, noses at the same level, the gap between them a charged centimeter of warm air. No posed perfection — just two real faces existing in the same private space, completely unguarded. The woman's face angled very slightly toward the man, his face turned gently toward hers — the natural gravitational pull of two people completely comfortable in each other's presence. Both expressions carrying the same quiet warmth — eyes half lidded and soft, the faintest natural smile sitting at the corners of both mouths without fully arriving, the specific expression of two people so deeply comfortable together that happiness requires no effort or performance. Completely real, completely human. Skin on both faces rendered at absolute forensic obsession level simultaneously — every individual pore on both faces with unique diameter, depth, shadow and wall structure visible. The woman's skin showing its own unique texture — smoother zones at the cheeks, natural pore distribution across the nose, subtle natural freckles, fine peach fuzz catching the warm light individually, natural lip skin texture at the vertical line level, delicate under-eye skin thinness. The man's skin showing its completely different biological texture — larger pores, individual stubble hairs at follicle level each casting its own micro-shadow, coarser skin surface, the natural roughness of male skin under the same warm light. The beautiful contrast of two completely different skin textures existing within the same frame and the same light — feminine smoothness against masculine texture, the biological difference between two people rendered at microscopic detail level. The space between their faces — that sacred charged gap — catching the warm light and making the air between them visible and alive. Where their skin comes closest the detail is most intense — the cheekbones almost touching, the warmth of proximity creating a very subtle natural flush on both faces in that zone. Lighting is a {argument name="lighting source" default="single warm candle-like source"} from slightly below and between them — intimate and alive, catching both skin textures simultaneously from the same angle, micro-shadows behind every pore on both faces at once. The light so warm and human it feels like it exists between them rather than above them. No artificial studio sources — just the most intimate light possible on the most intimate possible distance between two faces. Background is {argument name="background" default="pure warm black void"} — nothing exists except these two faces and the light between them. Color grading forensically warm and honest — true

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for mastering Manga Page Turns, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
共通キャラクター設定+描画ルール:
登場人物2名のキャラクターデザインを厳守すること。

先生({argument name="先生の名前" default="ミドリ先生"}): 黒髪ストレートのポニーテール、髪に薄い緑のメッシュが一筋。メガネ。ダボダボの体操ジャージの上に、サイズの合っていない大きめの白衣を羽織っている。表情豊かで元気、わんぱくな雰囲気だが教師としての誇りがある。動きが大きく、身振り手振りで熱く語る。
生徒({argument name="生徒の名前" default="ピンクちゃん"}): 薄いピンク色の髪、猫背、頭頂部にアホ毛が一本。常に眠そうな半目。おっとりした雰囲気で動作が遅い。机の上に液晶ペンタブレット(枕にする癖がある)、飲みかけのいちごミルク、うさぎのぬいぐるみ型ペンケースが置いてある。

画風・仕上げ指定:フルカラーで生成すること(モノクロ・グレースケール不可)。彩度はコメディ漫画らしく明るめ、ミドリ先生の髪は黒に薄い緑メッシュ、ピンクちゃんの髪は薄いピンクをはっきり発色させること。
コマ内にコマ番号(1、2、3などの数字ラベル)は一切表示しないこと。以下の「1コマ目」等の表記は指示用ラベルであり、画像内には描かない。
日本の商業漫画の正しい読み順に従い、コマ配置とキャラクターの視線・動作の向きは右から左へ流れるように厳守すること(右上のコマから開始し、右→左、上→下の順)。吹き出しの位置もこの読み順を妨げないよう配置する。
コマ枠は太めの黒線。セリフは日本語、読みやすく大きめ。舞台は漫画教室(ホワイトボード、机、液タブがある部屋)。

【1ページ目】縦長(3:4)、6コマ、右から左・上から下の順で配置:
1コマ目(右上、開始コマ・横長でページ幅いっぱい): タイトルコマ。手書き風の大きな文字で「{argument name="タイトル" default="『めくり』を制する者は漫画を制す"}」。ミドリ先生が単行本を1冊持ち、ページをめくる動作を大げさに実演している。ピンクちゃんは机で頬杖、半目。
2コマ目(2段目・右側): ピンクちゃんが気だるく質問。吹き出し「めくり…?ページをめくるだけのことに、名前があるんですかぁ…?」。頭上に「?」。
3コマ目(2段目・左側): ミドリ先生がメガネキラーンで食いつく。吹き出し「あるの!左ページ最後のコマ→めくる→右ページ最初のコマ。この橋渡しを『めくり』と呼んで、漫画家は技術の限りを尽くすの!」。背景に集中線。
4コマ目(3段目・横長、このページの主役コマとして大きく): 図解コマ。ホワイトボードに描かれた見開き構造の模式図: 開いた本の絵で、左ページの一番左下のコマに「引き!(次に何か起きそう)」のラベルと矢印、ページの間に「めくる=読者の目が紙面から完全に離れる時間」のラベル、右ページの一番右上のコマに「期待に応える良い絵・良いセリフ!」のラベルと矢印。矢印は読み順(右→左、めくって次ページ)に沿って描く。ミドリ先生がマーカーで模式図をビシッと指す。
5コマ目(4段目・右側): 比喩の解説コマ。ミドリ先生が胸に手を当てて語る。吹き出し「コマ割りのテンポは、人間の会話の口調と同じ。畳みかけるところと、ゆっくり話すところがある。その中で『めくり』は——息継ぎなの」。背景に音楽の休符のような柔らかいモチーフ。
6コマ目(4段目・左側): ピンクちゃんが半目のままぽつり。吹き出し「息継ぎ…わたしの人生、ずっと息継ぎみたいなものですねぇ…」。ミドリ先生の小さいツッコミ吹き出し「あなたのは潜水!(寝てる)」。

【2ページ目】縦長(3:4)、7コマ、右から左・上から下の順で配置:
1コマ目(右上、開始コマ・横長): ミドリ先生が解説の続き。吹き出し「めくりの間で読者の意識が離れちゃう。だから左ページの最後は『次に何か起きそうなコマ』か『自然な場面転換』を置くの!」。横に小さな例示イラスト: 漫画のコマ風に、キャラが何かに気づいてハッと振り向く「引き」のコマ。
2コマ目(2段目・横長): 続きの解説。吹き出し「そしてめくった先、右ページの最初のコマ。間があいた分、読者の期待値は上がってる。だからそれにふさわしい良いセリフ、良い絵を入れる!つまりめくりは——印象的なシーンの前の『タメ』!」。横に例示イラスト: めくった先で見開きのドーンとした決めゴマが現れるイメージ。
3コマ目(3段目・右側): ミドリ先生が実演を始める。単行本をピンクちゃんの前に置いて、わくわく顔。吹き出し「実際に体感してみて!ここ、左ページの最後のコマ…どう?めくりたくなるでしょ?」。
4コマ目(3段目・左側): ピンクちゃんが珍しく身を乗り出し、半目が少し開いて、ページに手をかける。吹き出し「あ…ほんとだ…ちょっと気になります…先が…」。瞳に小さなハイライトが一粒。
5コマ目(4段目・横長): ミドリ先生が感動と熱弁のピーク。白衣バサバサ。吹き出し「それ!!その『先が気になる』が積み重なると、"ページをめくる手が止まらない"作品になるの!!めくりは読者へのプレゼントなの!!」。背景に暖色の熱気トーン。
6コマ目(最下段・右側): ふと見ると、ピンクちゃんが開いた単行本に顔を突っ伏して熟睡している。本がそのまま枕になっている(いつもの液タブではなく)。頬ぷにっ、アホ毛ふよふよ、「すぴー…」。めくりかけのページが頬の下で少し折れている。
7コマ目(最下段・左側、締めコマ): がっくり崩れ落ちるミドリ先生。吹き出し「今日もか〜〜!!しかも本が枕!!」。倒れながら小さい吹き出し「…めくる手が、止まっちゃったわね…」。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for summer Festival Under Shooting Stars, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
主題：
{argument name="主題" default="流星を灯す夜"}

主体：
縦長2:3の夏祭りポートレート。濡れた石畳の上で、浴衣姿の女性が低くしゃがみ、左右の手に線香花火を一本ずつ持っている。人物は画面中央やや左から下半分を占め、広く残した夜空に色彩の異なる大輪の花火と、明瞭な流星が広がる。

人物・表情：
自然で現実感のある若い女性。黒髪を低めのゆるいまとめ髪にし、薄い前髪と頬にかかる後れ毛を残す。耳の後ろに淡い桃色と白の花飾りを添える。顔を画面右からカメラへ静かに振り向け、穏やかな目線と控えめな微笑みを見せる。線香花火と提灯の光が頬、鼻筋、唇に柔らかく触れる。

服装・ポーズ：
乳白色に近い淡い桜色の浴衣。桃色、薄紫、灰青色の小花と葉を散らした可憐な柄で、背中にはくすみピンクの大きな文庫結びの帯。足元は赤茶色の鼻緒を付けた木製の下駄。両足を揃えて深くしゃがみ、体は画面右へ向けながら上半身だけをカメラ側へひねる。人物自身の右手を胸の前へ少し高く上げ、左手を膝の横へ低く伸ばす。それぞれの手に線香花火を一本だけ自然につまみ、指の本数、握り方、手首の角度を正確に描く。

背景・光：
深い紺色の星空。左上には花びらのように湾曲して開く大きな桃色の花火、右上には金色と淡い青白色が放射状に伸びる大輪、左中段には青と桃色が混じる小さな花火を配置する。周囲には控えめな小型花火を数輪だけ散らし、密集させない。空を斜めに横切る流星を4〜5本描き、白く鋭い光点と長く透明感のある尾をはっきり見せる。画面左奥には暖色の提灯が遠近に沿って並び、右奥の水辺には朱色の鳥居と暗い山並みが見える。濡れた石畳に提灯、花火、線香花火の金色や桃色が長く反射する。主光は手元の線香花火、左側から提灯の暖かな補助光、上方から花火の淡い輪郭光を加える。

構図・カメラ：
縦2:3。低い位置から人物の目線付近を見上げるローアングルで、全身と下駄まで収める。人物の頭頂は画面中央付近、上半分以上を夜空の余白として確保する。左の提灯列が奥へ導く斜線を作り、右奥の鳥居と釣り合う構成。35mm相当の自然な広角感。人物と手元の線香花火に正確にピントを合わせ、背景は輪郭が分かる程度に柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
実写感の高い映画的な夜景写真。自然な肌理、浴衣の薄い綿布の織り、帯の立体的な折り目、濡れた石の光沢を丁寧に表現する。深い紺、淡い桃色、金色を中心に、彩度は上品に抑える。微細なフィルム粒子、滑らかな階調、透明感のある発光表現。過度な美肌補正を避け、現実的な光量と反射を保つ。

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for pachinko Debug Visualization Layout, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark technical debug visualization of a pachinko machine playfield layout, showing ball lanes, collision rails, pegs, named gameplay regions, and simulated ball trajectories.

Canvas: Square-ish 4:5 technical diagram on a nearly black burgundy background, with a transparent-engineering-overlay feel. Use a dark maroon grid of blocky rectangular obstacle silhouettes behind the layout.

Main layout: Draw a large pachinko board occupying almost the full canvas. The board is formed by thick angular golden-brown rails: one large outer oval/octagonal loop around the perimeter, one large inner polygonal ring around an empty central dark void, and several short rail segments near the bottom and lower-right. Keep the rails chunky, beveled, and slightly translucent, like debug collision geometry.

Trajectory paths: Add exactly 5 thin neon ball-path traces over the rails and lanes: 1 cyan path hugging the far-left launch lane, 1 hot pink path weaving near the left edge and bottom exit, 1 lime green path that curves from the upper-left across the mid-left and down to the bottom, 1 red path that crosses sharply through the left-middle and upper-left, and 1 yellow path following the outer left arc. The paths should overlap and look like simulated pachinko ball travel, with sharp turns and curved segments.

Debug regions: Draw dashed cyan rectangular region boxes with small cyan labels. Include exactly 7 labeled regions: "region:JACKPOT_1" at left-middle, "region:STATIC" near the lower-left/middle, "region:START" centered lower-middle, "region:LUCKY" right-lower-middle, "region:LAUNCHER" bottom-right, "region:OUT" lower-left exit area, and one tall dashed launch/channel region along the left side.

Pegs and labels: Add exactly 15 small green square peg markers with green debug labels. Place them around the central playfield: 2 near the upper-left labeled "peg-left-top-1" and "peg-left-top-2"; 3 near the top center labeled "peg-center-top-1", "peg-center-top-2", and "peg-1"; 3 on the upper-right labeled "peg-right-top-1", "peg-right-top-2", and "peg-right-path-2"; 3 on the lower-right/lower-middle labeled "peg-right-path-1", "peg-lucky-guide", and "peg-right-pocket-1"; 4 in the lower-left/lower-middle labeled "peg-left-path-1", "peg-left-pocket-1", "peg-start-left", and "peg-start-right". Make labels small, thin, and green, as if from a game-engine editor overlay.

Additional details: Include one tiny cyan number box reading "19" near the left-middle jackpot area. Add a few small red guide triangles and line fragments near the top-left lane. The diagram should look like a GPT-generated game-layout review screenshot rather than polished UI art.

Visual style: Low-light debug render, dark maroon and black palette, golden collision rails, cyan dashed UI overlays, green peg annotations, neon trajectory lines. No photorealism, no characters, no real pachinko machine cabinet, no decorative anime art.

Customizable concept: Build the layout as a {argument name="machine type" default="pachinko"} physics debug map titled by implication around {argument name="gameplay focus" default="ball trajectory and lane review"}. Use rail color {argument name="rail color" default="muted golden brown"}, background color {argument name="background color" default="near-black burgundy"}, and trajectory colors {argument name="trajectory colors" default="cyan, hot pink, lime green, red, yellow"}.

description.en: A production-ready image prompt for cinematic Coffee Journey Storyboard, reviewed against its published output.

entries.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium cinematic coffee commercial storyboard as a single static image, showing the full journey from coffee seed to finished latte. Use a dark minimalist studio look with pure black backgrounds, dramatic low-key lighting, shallow depth of field, macro photography realism, rich brown coffee tones, glossy highlights, and elegant white captions.

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen storyboard sheet, divided into exactly 10 vertical panels arranged in a 2-row by 5-column grid. Use thin dark gray dividers between panels. Each panel should feel like a high-end commercial still frame, with black negative space and a subject lit by a narrow soft spotlight.

Layout: Top row contains panels 1–5 with centered white caption text near the lower third but no visible numbers. Bottom row contains panels 6–10 with small white timing labels at the top left of each panel and centered white caption text near the bottom. Keep all typography clean, modern, sans-serif, white, and unobtrusive.

Storyboard panels, exactly 10:
1. A roasted-looking coffee seed partly embedded in dark soil, lit from the side, caption: “The coffee seed meets the soil.”
2. A coffee seed cracking open with a curved green sprout emerging upward from dark soil, caption: “The first sprout breaks through.”
3. A young coffee seedling with two fresh green leaves and thin pale roots visible in the soil, caption: “New life grows in the darkness.”
4. A taller green coffee sprout flanked by two split brown seed halves, caption: “The seed transforms, shaped by nature.”
5. A glossy green coffee cherry hanging from a thin branch in darkness, with a small droplet beneath it, caption: “The cherry ripens in silence.”
6. Bottom-left panel with top-left label “6   5.0 - 6.0s”; show a ripe red coffee cherry split open to reveal a pale bean inside, growing from dark soil, caption: “The bean is born, rich and whole.”
7. Top-left label “7   6.0 - 7.0s”; show a single roasted coffee bean floating or isolated against black, very close macro detail, caption: “From nature’s work to harvest.”
8. Top-left label “8   7.0 - 8.0s”; show finely ground coffee falling from a grinder into a portafilter held by a hand, caption: “Ground to perfection.”
9. Top-left label “9   8.0 - 9.0s”; show espresso extraction with two thin streams pouring from a portafilter into a dark cup below, caption: “Extracted with precision.”
10. Top-left label “10   9.0 - 10.0s”; show a barista hand pouring steamed milk from a metal pitcher into a cup of espresso, forming clean latte art, caption: “Crafted into a perfect harmony.”

Text customization: Use {argument name="brand mood" default="premium cinematic coffee commercial"} styling. The main caption tone should be poetic and minimal. Optionally replace the final caption with {argument name="final caption" default="Crafted into a perfect harmony."} while preserving the same placement.

Visual constraints: Keep exactly 10 panels, exactly 5 panels per row, and preserve the numbered timing labels only on panels 6 through 10. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra icons, extra panels, decorative borders, or unrelated text. Maintain realistic coffee textures, dark soil particles, deep blacks, warm highlights, and a luxurious commercial atmosphere.
